action.objective: Verify queen exchange Qxh4+ trades queens and advances development safely.
action.rationale: g4h4 leads broad search (346, exact depth 2) and is the reserved verification move. Black queen on h1 is en prise; after Qxh4 White must recapture with a developed piece, and Black's Nb8/Ng8 pieces are undeveloped. Verify no tactical refutation and that the queen trade sequence is favorable.
